title: Maximum curve speed
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the maximum speed on the curve using v_max = sqrt(μ g R).

title: Minimum deceleration magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the minimum deceleration on AB using kinematics: a_min = (v_A^2 - v_max^2) / (2 S_AB).

title: Centripetal force condition
description: Important: Identifies that the maximum static friction provides the centripetal force: μ m g = m v_max^2 / R.

title: Kinematics application
description: Important: Applies the correct kinematic equation (v_f^2 = v_i^2 + 2 a Δx) for uniformly decelerated motion on segment AB.

title: Road construction suggestion
description: Important: Proposes at least one valid method to increase the safe speed, such as banking the curve, increasing μ, or increasing R.

title: Sign error in deceleration
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect sign in the kinematic equation, leading to a negative deceleration magnitude or wrong sign for a_min.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Shows consistent use of SI units (m, s, m/s^2) throughout the calculation.

title: Force diagram or explanation
description: Optional: Includes a free-body diagram or clear verbal explanation of the forces on the car in the curve.
